rows.commentary: 4.1: Arshdeep Singh fires a hard length across Will Young, who flashes tentatively and watches it sail past his blade.
4.2: Arshdeep Singh offers width outside off and Will Young capitalizes instantly, punching it masterfully through sweeper cover for four.
4.3: Arshdeep Singh strikes as Will Young skies a top-edged pull into the leg side where Shreyas Iyer settles underneath it to complete the catch.
4.4: Arshdeep Singh serves up width to the left-hander who slaps it toward point, prompting a stunning diving stop from Axar that draws instant praise from Virat.
4.5: Arshdeep Singh sprays one down the leg side, but the umpire keeps his arms down as it skims past the red line.
4.6: Arshdeep Singh delivers on a length outside off, and Nicholls stays back to block it firmly into the turf.
5.1: Auqib Nabi pitches it full with a hint of movement, inducing a mistimed drive from Tim Seifert that trickles to cover on the bounce.
5.2: Auqib Nabi feeds the slot with a full and wide delivery, allowing Tim Seifert to hammer a ferocious drive over cover for four.
5.3: Auqib Nabi pulls his length back around off stump, and Tim Seifert stands tall to punch it cleanly into the off side.
5.4: Auqib Nabi goes full and wide once more, and Tim Seifert lashes through the gap at sweeper cover to collect another boundary.
5.5: Auqib Nabi tails one in late from a full length, catching the inside half of Tim Seifert's bat as it rolls away toward mid-wicket.
5.6: Auqib Nabi sharply cuts Tim Seifert in half with inward movement, eliciting a muted caught-behind appeal that India wisely choose not to review.
6.1: Arshdeep Singh lands it on a length around off, and Henry Nicholls dead-bats it securely.
6.2: Arshdeep Singh slides it full on off, meeting the middle of Henry Nicholls' bat as he defends solidly once more.
6.3: Arshdeep Singh digs it short and wide, prompting Henry Nicholls to slash uppishly past a desperate airborne dive from Axar Patel at backward point for four.
6.4: Henry Nicholls punches the delivery straight back down the pitch into the hands of Arshdeep Singh.
6.5: Henry Nicholls nudges it toward mid-on and scampers across for a single while Brar misses with an under-arm shy at the bowler's end.
14.6: Gurnoor Brar unleashes a sharp, steep bouncer that clears Daryl Mitchell's ducking helmet and eludes KL Rahul's desperate fingertips as it races away for five wides.
14.6: Gurnoor Brar keeps it shortish outside off, allowing Daryl Mitchell to simply knock the ball toward the cover fielder.
15.1: Anshul Kamboj steams in from round the wicket at 134kph, delivering a short of a good length around off that Tom Latham comfortably watches sail past.
15.2: Anshul Kamboj targets the channel outside off, and Tom Latham opens the face of his bat to steer a single down toward third man.
15.3: Anshul Kamboj tests the back of a length, prompting Daryl Mitchell to shuffle across the crease and work the ball securely through mid-wicket for one.
15.4: Anshul Kamboj angles one in around off stump that pins Tom Latham on the crease, catching the outside half of the bat to trickle down to third man.
15.5: Anshul Kamboj persists with a short delivery, and Daryl Mitchell swivels into position to turn it to his left for an effortless single.
15.6: Anshul Kamboj pitches on a length, inviting Tom Latham forward into a solid, defensive block.
16.1: Gurnoor Brar charges in at 141kph, dropping it short of a length around off for Daryl Mitchell, who stands tall to block it firmly into the off side.
16.2: Gurnoor Brar fires a short ball onto middle and leg, which Daryl Mitchell expertly maneuvers toward square leg before scampering across for a quick run.
16.3: Gurnoor Brar clocks 140kph with a back of a length delivery close to off, prompting Tom Latham to dab it neatly toward the backward point region.
16.4: Gurnoor Brar slips in a slightly fuller delivery, and Tom Latham pats it right back into the same point region without finding the gap.
16.5: Gurnoor Brar unleashes a searing 141 kph delivery that kicks off a short length and beats Tom Latham's outside edge as the batter tries to run it down to third man.
16.6: Gurnoor Brar plucks a stunning one-handed catch out of thin air with his left hand on the follow-through to dismiss Tom Latham.
17.1: Auqib Nabi targets a good length just outside off, drawing a forward prod from Daryl Mitchell into the off-side.
17.2: Auqib Nabi floats a fuller 126ks delivery that Daryl Mitchell drives sharply straight to the Indian captain stationed at mid-off.
28.1: Anshul Kamboj fires it in full outside off at 137ks, and Nathan Smith stretches out for the expansive drive only to jam a thick inside edge straight into his own back leg.
28.2: Anshul Kamboj bends his back for a 131ks back-of-a-length delivery outside off, which Nathan Smith hops on to and guides straight to Axar at backward point.
28.3: Anshul Kamboj tempts Nathan Smith with a full delivery that induces a thick outside edge, and Virat Kohli leaps low to his right at second slip to pull off a stunning catch.
28.4: Anshul Kamboj greets the incoming batter with a fiery bouncer, forcing Kyle Jamieson to half-duck and let it sail through.
28.4: Anshul Kamboj tests Kyle Jamieson with another sharp bumper outside off at 134ks, allowing the lanky batsman to drop his hands and watch it pass.
28.5: Anshul Kamboj spears in a 131ks length ball outside off, and Kyle Jamieson stays back to dab it toward the right of backward point.
28.6: Anshul Kamboj delivers a 131ks length ball outside off that Kyle Jamieson mistimes in his drive straight to Arshdeep at mid-on.
29.1: Arshdeep Singh comes round the wicket to target the stumps with a probing length ball, which Glenn Phillips calmly defends straight back down the pitch.
29.2: Arshdeep Singh feeds it around the off stump, allowing Glenn Phillips to wrist it behind square for a couple of runs before the fielder cuts it off in the deep.
29.3: Arshdeep Singh switches over the wicket for a sharp short-of-length delivery that Glenn Phillips hops onto and blocks back to the bowler.
29.4: Arshdeep Singh serves up a fullish delivery outside off, and Glenn Phillips pushes it firmly towards the cover fielder.
29.5: Arshdeep Singh angles a full delivery just outside off, prompting Glenn Phillips to gently tap it toward cover.
29.6: Arshdeep Singh drops it short, and Glenn Phillips fetches a top-edged pull over a vacant fine leg for six.
30.1: Anshul Kamboj tests the fourth-stump corridor, leaving Kyle Jamieson grasping at thin air with an empty drive.
30.2: Anshul Kamboj keeps it outside off, allowing Kyle Jamieson to nudge a quick single into the cover region.
30.3: Glenn Phillips does not score off Anshul Kamboj.
38.2: Gurnoor Brar extracts sharp bounce from a short length to outsmart Blair Tickner, zipping cleanly past the flashing blade.
38.3: Blair Tickner hurriedly backtracks from a steep delivery, scraping a fortunate single just past the outstretched fingertips at mid-on.
38.4: Gurnoor Brar tests Jacob Duffy with another sharp bumper that whistles untouched through to the wicketkeeper.
38.5: Gurnoor Brar hurls a 140kph missile past Jacob Duffy's wild pull, immediately engaging in a sharp verbal challenge.
38.6: Gurnoor Brar pounds away relentlessly on a heavy length, leaving Jacob Duffy grasping at thin air once again.
39.1: Axar Patel slides one through sharply on the stumps, beating Blair Tickner's forward defensive prod.
39.2: Axar Patel keeps it flat and precise, allowing Blair Tickner to neatly dead-bat the ball into the off-side.
39.3: Axar Patel tosses it up slightly fuller, and Blair Tickner drives it firmly down the ground to long-off.
39.4: Axar Patel darts a flatter delivery in, allowing Jacob Duffy to advance and whip it cleanly toward mid-wicket.
39.5: Axar Patel delivers an inviting full ball that Blair Tickner effortlessly nudges down to long-on.
39.6: Axar Patel offers width outside off, drawing a bottom-edged cut from Jacob Duffy that bounces safely through to KL.
40.1: Gurnoor Brar digs another short ball into the surface as Blair Tickner misses wildly, sparking a lively exchange of words between bowler and batter.
40.2: Gurnoor Brar persists with the bumper, inducing the fatal top-edge as Blair Tickner backs away to heave, leaving KL to glide comfortably to his left for the catch.
